en: Sepia-toned aerial or elevated view of a large urban square with wide streets and early-to-mid 20th‑century cars and pedestrians. On the left is a multi‑storey block, in the center a prominent theater‑like building with an ornate façade, and in the background a street leads uphill toward a church with several onion domes and a bell tower. The right margin contains a short printed caption in Russian in the upper corner.
